4039def _prepare_view_class(view_cls: type[View]) -> None: 

4040 """Run the one-time class-level setup for a View.

4043 not inherited from a parent class that was registered separately). Calling 

4044 this multiple times is a no-op after the first run. 

4045 """

4047 return

4049 _warn_on_misuse(view_cls) 

4050 _copy_all_parent_class_endpoints_into_this_subclass(view_cls) 

4051 _init_all_endpoints(view_cls) 

4052 view_cls.before_include_view() 

4053 _reject_buried_markers_in_view_schemas(view_cls) 

4054 _init_class_based_view(view_cls) 

4055 view_cls._fr_initialised = True # type: ignore[attr-defined]

4058def _copy_all_parent_class_endpoints_into_this_subclass(view_cls: type[View]): 

4059 """ 

4060 Override all methods with a @route decorator of the parent classes of view_cls 

4061 with a new copy directly on view_cls . This allows us to change the 

4062 annotations on these endpoints without affecting the parent endpoints. 

4063 

4064 For example, FooView.get() delegates to AsyncRestView.get() if it is not 

4065 overridden (this is called implicit delegation through method resolution). And if 

4066 we add the annotation that FooView.get() returns FooSchema but do not make a copy 

4067 then AsyncRestView.get() and all other subclasses will get the FooSchema 

4068 annotation as well. 

4069 """ 

4070 for name, endpoint in _get_all_parent_endpoints(view_cls).items(): 

4071 # `name` is the attribute key (e.g. "get_many_endpoint"), which is stable 

4072 # across copies; `endpoint.__name__` may have been mangled by a parent's 

4073 # own registration (e.g. "parentview_get_many_endpoint"), so key off the 

4074 # attribute name throughout. 

4075 if name in view_cls.__dict__: 

4076 # This endpoint is already overridden! 

4077 continue 

4078 

4079 # The original endpoint might be shared between subclasses. 

4080 # So make a copy and put that on the view_cls. 

4081 endpoint_wrapper = _make_copy(endpoint, view_cls) 

4082 if getattr(endpoint, "__module__", "").startswith("fastapi_restly."): 

4083 # The shells carry override-redirect docstrings for help()/source 

4084 # readers. FastAPI reads endpoint.__doc__ as the OpenAPI operation 

4085 # description, so strip the copy: framework guidance must not leak 

4086 # into the user's API docs. User-defined endpoints keep theirs. 

4087 endpoint_wrapper.__doc__ = None 

4088 # Reset the copy's name to the endpoint attribute so downstream renaming 

4089 # produces "<view>_<name>" even when the source was a parent's renamed 

4090 # copy. 

4091 endpoint_wrapper.__name__ = name 

4092 # Set explicit __qualname__ for debugging purposes. 

4093 endpoint_wrapper.__qualname__ = f"{view_cls.__name__}_{name}_wrapper" 

4094 setattr(view_cls, name, endpoint_wrapper) 

4095 

4096 

4097def _make_copy(endpoint: Callable, view_cls: type[View]) -> Callable: 

4098 """ 

4099 Wrap the endpoint in a new function as kind of copy. 

4100 

4101 Fun fact: You cannot do this inside a for loop, because the closure of 'endpoint' 

4102 inside the wrapper works on the variable, not on the value. And for-loops in Python 

4103 do not have their own variable scope. 

4104 

4105 https://eev.ee/blog/2011/04/24/gotcha-python-scoping-closures/ 

4106 """ 

4107 if inspect.iscoroutinefunction(endpoint): 

4108 

4109 async def _async_wrapper(self, *args, **kwargs): 

4110 return await endpoint(self, *args, **kwargs) 

4111 

4112 endpoint_wrapper: Callable = _async_wrapper 

4113 else: 

4114 

4115 def _sync_wrapper(self, *args, **kwargs): 

4116 return endpoint(self, *args, **kwargs) 

4117 

4118 endpoint_wrapper = _sync_wrapper 

4119 

4120 return _wrap_endpoint(endpoint_wrapper, endpoint) 

4121 

4122 

4123def _wrap_endpoint(wrapper: Callable, endpoint: Callable) -> Callable: 

4124 """Copy the endpoint's metadata and globals onto a wrapper.""" 

4125 # FastAPI 0.115 resolves string annotations against the wrapper's 

4126 # globals; FastAPI 0.128 and later unwrap the endpoint first. These 

4127 # wrappers read only their arguments and closure, so the endpoint's 

4128 # globals can replace this module's without changing what they do. 

4129 copied = types.FunctionType( 

4130 wrapper.__code__, 

4131 inspect.unwrap(endpoint).__globals__, 

4132 wrapper.__name__, 

4133 wrapper.__defaults__, 

4134 wrapper.__closure__, 

4135 ) 

4136 functools.update_wrapper(copied, endpoint) 

4137 copied.__annotations__ = endpoint.__annotations__.copy() 

4138 return copied 

4139

4141def _init_all_endpoints(view_cls: type[View]): 

4142 """ 

4143 Ensure every endpoint has a unique name and update the 'self' annotation. 

4144 """ 

4145 for name, attr in view_cls.__dict__.items(): 

4146 if not hasattr(attr, "_api_route_args"): 

4147 continue 

4148 endpoint = attr 

4149 # Give every endpoint a unique name: FooView.create_endpoint gets 

4150 # "fooview_create_endpoint". From the attribute, as for a copied 

4151 # endpoint, not from __name__: a registration that failed has renamed 

4152 # the endpoint already, and a retry must not add the prefix again. 

4153 endpoint.__name__ = view_cls.__name__.lower() + "_" + name 

4154 _annotate_self(view_cls, endpoint)

4187def _fill_view_types( 

4188 func: Callable, view_types: Mapping[str, Any], list_params: Any 

4189) -> None: 

4190 """Put the view's classes in place of the markers in ``func.__signature__``. 

4191 

4192 A parameter named ``list_params`` always takes the view's list params, 

4193 whatever its annotation says: the unknown-key guard checks the keys 

4194 against them. 

4195 """ 

4196 # Read what the author wrote, not the signature: functools.update_wrapper 

4197 # copies a registered parent's filled-in signature onto a subclass's copy. 

4198 written = inspect.get_annotations(func) 

4199 sig = inspect.signature(func) 

4200 changed = False 

4201 params = [] 

4202 for param in sig.parameters.values(): 

4203 if param.name == "list_params": 

4204 annotation = list_params 

4205 elif param.name in written: 

4206 annotation = _with_view_types(written[param.name], func, view_types) 

4207 else: 

4208 annotation = param.annotation 

4209 changed = changed or annotation is not param.annotation 

4210 params.append(param.replace(annotation=annotation)) 

4211 returns = sig.return_annotation 

4212 if "return" in written: 

4213 returns = _with_view_types(written["return"], func, view_types) 

4214 if changed or returns is not sig.return_annotation: 

4215 func.__signature__ = sig.replace( # type: ignore[attr-defined] 

4216 parameters=params, return_annotation=returns 

4217 )

4220def _with_view_types( 

4221 annotation: Any, func: Callable, view_types: Mapping[str, Any] 

4222) -> Any: 

4223 """``annotation`` with the view's classes in place of its markers. 

4224 

4225 It is ``annotation`` itself when it holds no marker. So an annotation 

4226 that is a string, under ``from __future__ import annotations``, stays a 

4227 string for FastAPI to resolve.

4229 evaluated = _evaluated(annotation, func) 

4230 filled = _replace_view_types(evaluated, view_types) 

4231 return annotation if filled is evaluated else filled

4234def _evaluated(annotation: Any, func: Callable) -> Any: 

4235 """A string annotation, evaluated in the module of the route's author. 

4236 

4237 A string that does not evaluate there, such as one that names a class of 

4238 a function body, stays a string. 

4239 """ 

4240 if not isinstance(annotation, str): 

4241 return annotation 

4242 try: 

4243 return eval(annotation, inspect.unwrap(func).__globals__) # noqa: S307 

4244 except Exception: 

4245 return annotation

4248def _replace_view_types(annotation: Any, view_types: Mapping[str, Any]) -> Any: 

4249 """Replace each marker in ``annotation``, also inside a type such as

4264 return Annotated[(filled_inner, *metadata)] 

4265 args = get_args(annotation) 

4266 if not args or origin is Literal: 

4267 return annotation 

4268 filled_args = tuple(_replace_view_types(arg, view_types) for arg in args) 

4269 if all(new is old for new, old in zip(filled_args, args)): 

4270 return annotation 

4271 if origin in (Union, types.UnionType):

4341def _view_response_kind(view_cls: Any, endpoint: Callable) -> tuple[str | None, Any]: 

4342 """How a route answers with the view's response, and the response model

4346 ``"list"`` for a ``ListResult``. It comes from the response that the route

4348 annotation. A marker of the view's response, the view's own response 

4349 class, or the view's model in the return annotation, declares the view's 

4350 response, also with ``| None``. Another class that the route names keeps 

4351 FastAPI's behaviour.

4355 if in_decorator: 

4356 declared = route_kwargs["response_model"] 

4357 else: 

4358 declared = inspect.get_annotations(endpoint).get("return") 

4359 declared, optional = _without_none(_evaluated(declared, endpoint)) 

4360 kind, response_model = _declared_view_response(view_cls, declared, in_decorator) 

4361 if optional and response_model is not None: 

4362 response_model = Union[response_model, None]

4366def _declared_view_response(

4374 :func:`~fastapi_restly.schemas.derive_schema_response`: each call with 

4375 the same schema returns that same class.

4382 return "list", None 

4383 if get_origin(declared) is list:

4394def _with_view_response( 

4395 view_cls: Any, endpoint: Callable, route_kwargs: dict[str, Any] 

4396) -> tuple[Callable, dict[str, Any]]: 

4397 """The endpoint that FastAPI calls, and its route arguments. 

4398 

4399 A route that declares the view's response answers through the view's 

4400 response step, also when it returns the row: a row goes through 

4401 :meth:`~BaseRestView.to_response`, each row of a list, or of another 

4402 iterable such as the result of ``session.scalars()``, through 

4403 :meth:`~BaseRestView.to_single_response`, and a ``ListResult`` through 

4404 ``to_response(result, ResponseShape.LIST)``. Anything else, such as 

4405 ``None`` or a response object that the route built itself, goes out as 

4406 it is. 

4407 """ 

4408 kind, response_model = _view_response_kind(view_cls, endpoint) 

4409 if kind is None: 

4410 return endpoint, route_kwargs 

4411 if response_model is not None: 

4412 route_kwargs = {**route_kwargs, "response_model": response_model} 

4413 signature = inspect.signature(endpoint) 

4414 self_name = next(iter(signature.parameters)) 

4415 

4416 def respond(view: Any, result: Any) -> Any: 

4417 if kind == "single" and isinstance(result, view.model): 

4418 return view.to_response(result) 

4419 if kind == "many" and _is_rows(result): 

4420 rows = list(result) 

4421 if all(isinstance(row, view.model) for row in rows): 

4422 return [view.to_single_response(row) for row in rows] 

4423 # the iterable is used up: send the items that it gave 

4424 return rows 

4425 if kind == "list" and isinstance(result, ListResult): 

4426 return view.to_response(result, ResponseShape.LIST) 

4427 return result 

4428 

4429 if inspect.iscoroutinefunction(endpoint): 

4430 

4431 @functools.wraps(endpoint) 

4432 async def wrapped(*args: Any, **kwargs: Any) -> Any: 

4433 result = await endpoint(*args, **kwargs) 

4434 return respond(args[0] if args else kwargs[self_name], result) 

4435 

4436 else: 

4437 

4438 @functools.wraps(endpoint) 

4439 def wrapped(*args: Any, **kwargs: Any) -> Any: 

4440 result = endpoint(*args, **kwargs) 

4441 return respond(args[0] if args else kwargs[self_name], result) 

4442 

4443 # FastAPI reads string annotations in the module of the function it 

4444 # calls; an older FastAPI does not look through the wrapper 

4445 wrapped.__signature__ = signature.replace( # type: ignore[attr-defined] 

4446 parameters=[ 

4447 param.replace(annotation=_evaluated(param.annotation, endpoint)) 

4448 for param in signature.parameters.values() 

4449 ], 

4450 return_annotation=( 

4451 response_model 

4452 if response_model is not None 

4453 else _evaluated(signature.return_annotation, endpoint) 

4454 ), 

4455 )

4462 return isinstance(result, Iterable) and not isinstance( 

4463 result, (str, bytes, Mapping, pydantic.BaseModel, Response)

4486def _get_all_parent_endpoints(view_cls: type[View]) -> dict[str, Callable]:

4490 Keying by most-derived attribute name prevents duplicate logical endpoints 

4491 while still respecting overrides.

4501 # base regardless of whether that override is itself a route. 

4502 continue 

4503 seen.add(name) 

4504 if hasattr(value, "_api_route_args"): 

4505 endpoints[name] = value 

4506 return endpoints

4513 # cannot drop a guard its base declares.

4516 dependencies: list[Any] = []

4518 for level in levels: 

4519 for dependency in level.get("dependencies") or (): 

4520 # A subclass that spells out ``[own, *Base.dependencies]`` lists 

4521 # the base's entries again. They move to where it lists them, so 

4522 # ``own`` still runs first.

4524 dependencies.append(dependency) 

4525 responses.update(level.get("responses") or {})

4528 prefix=prefix, tags=tags, responses=responses, dependencies=dependencies

4532 list_parameters: list[dict[str, Any]] | None = None

4534 for name, attr in view_cls.__dict__.items():

4536 continue

4538 if view_types is not None and not _serves_route(view_cls, name): 

4539 continue 

4540 endpoint = attr 

4541 if view_types is not None: 

4542 path, route_kwargs = _view_route_args(endpoint, view_types) 

4543 else: 

4544 path, route_kwargs = endpoint._api_route_args 

4545 _reject_view_types_on_a_plain_view(view_cls, name, endpoint, route_kwargs) 

4546 defaults = {}

4552 defaults = {

4554 "summary": summary,

4556 functools.partial( 

4557 _generate_crud_operation_id,

4565 view_cls, endpoint, route_kwargs

4590def _generate_crud_operation_id( 

4591 route: fastapi.routing.APIRoute, *, is_member: bool 

4592) -> str: 

4593 """Combine the mounted resource path and action, omitting the member key.""" 

4594 path = route.path_format.rstrip("/") 

4595 if is_member: 

4596 path = re.sub(r"/\{[^}]+\}$", "", path) 

4597 segments = [ 

4598 f"by_{segment[1:-1]}" if segment.startswith("{") else segment 

4599 for segment in path.strip("/").split("/") 

4600 if segment 

4601 ] 

4602 resource = re.sub(r"\W+", "_", "_".join(segments)).strip("_") or "root" 

4603 action = {"get_many": "list", "get_one": "get"}.get(route.name, route.name) 

4604 return re.sub(r"\W+", "_", f"{resource}_{action}").strip("_")

4613def _derive_tag_from_prefix(prefix: str) -> str | None:

4615 if not segments:

4617 return segments[-1].replace("-", " ").replace("_", " ").title()

4640def _annotate_self(view_cls: type[View], endpoint: Callable) -> None: 

4641 """ 

4642 Annotate the 'self' argument as 'self=Depends(view_cls)'. That way FastAPI instantiates the 

4643 view_cls before calling the endpoint function and passes it as 'self'. 

4644 Note that it sets endpoint.__signature__ which overrides any other inspection. 

4645 

4646 Note: Copied (MIT license) and adjusted from: https://github.com/dmontagu/fastapi-utils/blob/master/fastapi_utils/cbv.py 

4647 

4648 Fixes the endpoint signature to ensure FastAPI performs dependency injection properly. 

4649 """ 

4650 sig = inspect.signature(endpoint) 

4651 params: list[inspect.Parameter] = list(sig.parameters.values()) 

4652 self_param = params[0] 

4653 new_self_param = self_param.replace(default=fastapi.Depends(view_cls)) 

4654 

4655 new_params = [new_self_param] + [ 

4656 param.replace(kind=inspect.Parameter.KEYWORD_ONLY) for param in params[1:] 

4657 ] 

4658 endpoint.__signature__ = sig.replace(parameters=new_params) # type: ignore[attr-defined] 

4659 

4660 

4661# Bare-typed annotations FastAPI special-cases for parameter injection 

4662# (no ``Depends(...)`` marker required). Treated alongside ``Depends``- 

4663# marked annotations as dependency class attributes; everything else is 

4664# left as plain typing. 

4665_FASTAPI_SPECIAL_INJECTABLE: tuple[type, ...] = ( 

4666 Request, 

4667 Response, 

4668 BackgroundTasks, 

4669 WebSocket, 

4670) 

4671 

4672# Markers for the request inputs FastAPI reads into an endpoint parameter: 

4673# ``Path``/``Query``/``Header``/``Cookie`` (``Param``) and ``Body``/``Form``/ 

4674# ``File`` (``Body``). FastAPI fills a class attribute only through ``Depends`` 

4675# or a special type, never through one of these, so the view is rejected. 

4676_REQUEST_PARAMETER_MARKERS: tuple[type, ...] = (_ParamMarker, _BodyMarker) 

4677 

4678 

4679def _init_class_based_view(view_cls: type[View]) -> None: 

4680 """ 

4681 Note: Copied (MIT license) and adjusted from: https://github.com/dmontagu/fastapi-utils/blob/master/fastapi_utils/cbv.py 

4682 

4683 Idempotently modifies the provided `cls`, performing the following modifications: 

4684 * The `__init__` function is updated to set any class-annotated dependencies as instance attributes 

4685 * The `__signature__` attribute is updated to indicate to FastAPI what arguments should be passed to the initializer

4687 if getattr(view_cls, "__class_based_view", False): 

4688 return # Already initialized

4690 old_signature = inspect.signature(old_init) 

4691 old_parameters = list(old_signature.parameters.values())[1:] # drop `self` 

4692 new_parameters = [ 

4693 x 

4694 for x in old_parameters 

4695 if x.kind 

4696 not in (inspect.Parameter.VAR_POSITIONAL, inspect.Parameter.VAR_KEYWORD) 

4697 ] 

4698 # Marker-based DI with MRO-aware shadowing: walk the MRO from the 

4699 # base classes upward and pick, for each name, an annotation that 

4700 # either carries a ``Depends(...)`` marker or names one of FastAPI's 

4701 # bare-injectable special types (``Request`` / ``Response`` etc.). 

4702 # A *plain* annotation on a more-derived class (e.g. a mixin 

4703 # declaring ``session: AsyncSession`` for static-typing purposes) 

4704 # does NOT shadow a marker-bearing annotation from a base — the 

4705 # framework keeps the dependency over the most-derived hint. 

4706 # Without this rule, any plain annotation a mixin adds would 

4707 # silently break dependency injection. 

4708 di_annotations: dict[str, Any] = {} 

4709 request_markers: dict[str, Any] = {} 

4710 for cls in reversed(view_cls.__mro__): 

4711 try: 

4712 cls_hints = get_type_hints(cls, include_extras=True) 

4713 except Exception: 

4714 continue 

4715 for name, annotation in cls_hints.items(): 

4716 if get_origin(annotation) is ClassVar: 

4717 continue 

4718 metadata = getattr(annotation, "__metadata__", ()) 

4719 has_depends_marker = any(isinstance(m, _DependsMarker) for m in metadata) 

4720 for marker in metadata: 

4721 if isinstance(marker, _REQUEST_PARAMETER_MARKERS): 

4722 request_markers.setdefault(name, marker) 

4723 underlying = ( 

4724 annotation 

4725 if get_origin(annotation) is not Annotated 

4726 else (get_args(annotation)[0] if get_args(annotation) else annotation) 

4727 ) 

4728 is_special_type = inspect.isclass(underlying) and issubclass( 

4729 underlying, _FASTAPI_SPECIAL_INJECTABLE 

4730 )

4734 # Plain annotations are silently ignored — they neither set 

4735 # nor clear an entry in di_annotations. 

4736 

4737 # FastAPI never fills an attribute with a request-parameter marker: it 

4738 # would keep its class default, with no error and no OpenAPI entry. A 

4739 # Depends marker on the same name makes it a dependency, as above. 

4740 for name, marker in request_markers.items(): 

4741 if name not in di_annotations: 4741 ↛ 4740line 4741 didn't jump to line 4740 because the condition on line 4741 was always true

4742 raise RestlyConfigurationError( 

4743 f"{view_cls.__name__}.{name} has a {type(marker).__name__}() " 

4744 "marker, but a view class attribute is filled only through " 

4745 "Depends(...) or Security(...), so FastAPI would never set it. " 

4746 "Declare the parameter on the endpoint method that reads it, " 

4747 f"or annotate {name} with Annotated[..., Depends(...)] and read " 

4748 "the parameter in that dependency." 

4749 ) 

4750 

4751 dependency_names: list[str] = [] 

4752 for name, annotation in di_annotations.items(): 

4753 dependency_names.append(name) 

4754 default_value = getattr(view_cls, name, inspect.Parameter.empty) 

4755 new_parameters.append( 

4756 inspect.Parameter( 

4757 name=name, 

4758 kind=inspect.Parameter.KEYWORD_ONLY, 

4759 default=default_value, 

4760 annotation=annotation, 

4761 ) 

4762 ) 

4763 new_signature = old_signature.replace(parameters=new_parameters) 

4764 

4765 def new_init(self: Any, *args: Any, **kwargs: Any) -> None: 

4766 for dep_name in dependency_names: 

4767 dep_value = kwargs.pop(dep_name) 

4768 setattr(self, dep_name, dep_value) 

4769 old_init(self, *args, **kwargs) 

4770 

4771 setattr(view_cls, "__signature__", new_signature) 

4772 setattr(view_cls, "__init__", new_init) 

4773 setattr(view_cls, "__class_based_view", True)
